rubric_items.reason: activeOnWeekday, onDutyToday, DashboardService.get and DashboardPage are all exercised; every REQ-1..REQ-14 has a named test at API or web level.
Most assertions check exact response rows and rendered cells; the web order test uses data already sorted by free, so it cannot tell API order from a client re-sort.
Strong edges: slot starting exactly now, local-midnight weekday, Saturday, all-zero ties, inactive, fully booked. No new error-path test; bad period 400 stays covered only by existing DSH-7.
Vitest+Supertest on throwaway PostgreSQL with fixed clock, Vitest+Testing Library for web, test names start with requirement IDs, in the existing test folders.
No pass counts or coverage invented; defers results to the verifier and states coverage is skipped, matching the verifier's coverage skip.

findings.text: The REQ-6 test depends on bookings made by the earlier REQ-4 test in the same database (booked: 3 counts the REQ-4 appointments), so it fails if run alone or reordered. The artifact does not mention this coupling.

cites.quote: **REQ-6:** the next free slot skips a slot that is now booked.

findings.suggested_fix: Make the REQ-6 test set up its own bookings (or a fresh database), or assert relative to the day schedule from /:id/slots instead of a hard-coded booked count.

findings.text: The web order test feeds rows already sorted by free (5 then 2), so a page that re-sorted by free would pass too; it does not prove 'rows show in API order'.

cites.quote: { doctorId: 7, fullName: 'Dr. Test Doctor Seven', department: 'Outpatient', booked: 1, free: 5,
the "On duty today" rows show in API order

findings.suggested_fix: Give the stub rows an order that differs from free-descending and name order, and assert the rendered order matches the stub.

findings.text: Duplicate setup code: each of the four new web tests repeats the fetch stub and MemoryRouter render block instead of a shared helper.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract a renderWith(data) helper that stubs fetch and renders DashboardPage in MemoryRouter.

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock.
Vitest with jsdom and Testing Library
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script)
Kolkata is UTC+05:30 all year, so local HH:MM on a day maps to a fixed UTC instant.
The design adds an `onDuty` array to GET /api/dashboard.
